messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — I'm starting a scoped plan for a staged onprem/VPC rollout for the next pilot customers (Acme, Beta Labs). We need to lock the network handoff model, upgrade lanes, and launch gates. Quick sync?

alex_w: Proposed lanes: 1) operator-shim (minimal footprint, in-tenant) 2) relay/egress-relay mode (customer NAT + our relay) 3) full VPC peering (BGP/peering). Each has different rollback guarantees. Which do we treat as GA path?

sam_ops: Customers keep asking to preserve existing egress IPs during upgrades. NetOps requested a 2-week rollback window and clear fail-open paths. Can we meet that on lane 3?

devon_pm: Draft launch criteria: - Canary on 2 customers for 2 weeks - Automated rollback with <15min scripted path - Console exposes per-tenant egress mapping and upgrade status - Runbooks for ops + field. Thoughts?

taylor_eng: Implementation note: add installer flag `--network-mode={operator,relay,peering}` and validate `--kms` on install time. We'll need unit+e2e tests that exercise IP-preserve migration. Example CLI: `installer install --network-mode=operator --kms=aws-kms://alias/redwood`

jen_security: +1 on KMS check. Also require HSM-compatible KMS support and audit-log hooks before GA for regulated customers. We should enumerate the compliance gating list (SOC2, PCI-like customers).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy successful — priv-operator-shim image v0.5.3 deployed to priv-staging (build #3421).

alex_w: Risk callout: for peering lane, customer's IPAM + our node IPs can collide. Need mapping template and a strict ACL handshake. We should publish a schema for netops teams to sign.

sam_ops: Migration story question — for customers on distro v1 (no shim), do we provide a rolling in-place upgrade or a sidecar migration? Zero-downtime is top ask.

maria_g: My recommendation: two upgrade paths. Hot-path: operator-shim in-place with prefix/KV cache preservation. Cold-path: migration helper that snapshots config, creates new nodes, flips traffic during a maintenance window. Hot-path is our priority for PLG customers, cold-path for strict netops enterprises.

devon_pm: Dependencies & timeline ask: what do we need to deliver to call this "pilot-ready"? My checklist: 1) netops interface spec 2) installer flag + smoke tests 3) runbook + rollback steps 4) console telemetry for mapping 5) compliance checklist. Estimated target: 6 weeks if no major blockers.

taylor_eng: Rough engineering ETA: shim + installer flag + basic mapping telemetry = ~6w. Migration helper + peering automation = +3w. Need netops sign-off earlier. Also need perf bench for <=10% latency overhead.

jen_security: I'll own the compliance gating doc. Need time to validate HSM paths in the offline installer (airgap) flow. That will affect Private GA for regulated customers.

alex_w: Action item: I'll draft the netops interface spec and the ACL/IP mapping schema — will drop a first pass in this thread by EOD Friday and ping netops.

sam_ops: I'll draft the runbook + rollback playbook and include exact commands for traffic flip and smoke checks.

maria_g: Great. Final proposed actions: 1) Alex: netops spec by EOD Fri. 2) Taylor: spike on `--network-mode` and tests (2-week spike). 3) Sam: runbook + rollback. 4) Jen: compliance gating draft. 5) Devon: coordinate pilot customers and schedule canaries. We'll reconvene Tue next week with artifacts. :thumbsup:

alex_w: Noted. I'll also add a short checklist for customer pre-checks (IP lists, firewall rules, peering keys).

ops-bot: reminder-bot: meeting scheduled Tue 10:00am to review artifacts.

maria_g: Thanks all — let's keep updates concise in this thread. If anyone finds an unexpected blocker, call it out here and tag netops.
